title: Crown subsidiaries and Province-held companies, 1974–2026
scope: Rosters of companies the Province, or a Crown body, held or listed as subsidiaries, from the sources the 2026-11-22 subsidiary research package used (reviews/subsidiaries-2026-11-22). Each roster is printed as the source has it, with what the source says was held; match_ids name the atlas record a row was matched to. These are observations, not lifecycles: a percentage held, an advance or a listing is not ownership over a period, and a minority investment is not a subsidiary. Rosters marked 'transcribed: research package' were not re-read during integration.
